name: Digital Edge CGK Campus (GIIC, Bekasi)
notes: CGK Campus: US$4.5bn AI-ready hyperscale campus announced 28 Jan 2026 in GIIC Industrial Estate, Cikarang/Bekasi, West Java; up to 500MW IT load across four buildings, scalable to 1GW campus-wide; US$665M green loan (Mar 2026) funds first phase with Q4 2026 target. Operator-official A for announcement/loan; full-build 500MW is campus planning figure, first phase under financing.

name: PDG JC3 (GIIC Kota Deltamas, Bekasi)
notes: JC3 AI-ready hyperscale campus, Greenland International Industrial Center (GIIC), Bekasi Regency, West Java; groundbreaking 19 Nov 2025, USD 1bn investment, 120MW across two buildings; US$856M raised May 2026 for buildout. Operator release A; DCD/W.Media B.

name: DCI H2 Campus (Karawang)
developer: PT DCI Indonesia Tbk / Salim Group (PT Datacenter Indonesia Sukses Makmur)
notes: DCI H2 campus, Karawang, West Java: H2-01 15MW operational Nov 2021, H2-02 27MW IT load solar-powered (first solar DC in Indonesia) inaugurated Jun 2023; campus on 791 ha with up to 600MW total capacity. capacity_mw=42 is current H2-01+H2-02 IT load; 600MW is long-term campus narrative (B).

name: STT Jakarta Campus (GIIC, Cikarang)
developer: ST Telemedia Global Data Centres (STT GDC) / Triputra Group JV
notes: STT Jakarta 1 operational with 19.5MW critical IT capacity (carbon-neutral ops); campus in GIIC/Kota Deltamas, Cikarang, Bekasi planned for up to 72MW across multiple buildings; 2026 expansion of Rp8.8T green funding platform supports STT Jakarta 3 and campus buildout. 360MW long-term campus narrative reported by trade press (B); current IT load 19.5MW.

name: NTT Jakarta 3 (MM2100, Bekasi)
developer: NTT Global Data Centers / NTT Communications
notes: NTT Jakarta 3, MM2100 industrial estate, Bekasi, West Java: purpose-built 4-storey DC, 18,800 sqm IT space, 45.6MW critical IT load; launched Apr 2022 at 15.2MW, designed for up to 45MW/45.6MW fully developed. NTT official page A; DCD B.

name: BDx CGK4 AI Campus (Jatiluhur)
developer: BDx Data Centers / Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison / Lintasarta JV
notes: CGK4 campus at Jatiluhur, Purwakarta area, West Java: Phase-1 completion announced 31 Jul 2024, Indonesia's first renewable-powered AI campus and first NVIDIA DGX-Ready certified campus; 500MW renewable-powered AI campus plan; up to 120kW/rack liquid cooling; BDx reports 1.2GW PLN grid power commitment. Phase 1 operational (A for operator release); 500MW/1.2GW are campus/power-commitment figures (B).

name: Microsoft Indonesia Central region / Karawang data center
notes: Microsoft Indonesia Central cloud region (West Java, 3 AZ) opened 27 May 2025 (official A for region existence). Press/B reports 48MW data center under construction in Karawang International Industrial City (KIIC) as part of US$1.7bn investment; W.Media reports 200MW renewables secured Feb 2026. Physical Karawang facility is B-grade (trade press) pending permit/PLN corroboration.

name: DayOne Batam (Nongsa Digital Park)
notes: 72MW hyperscale data center inside Nongsa Digital Park Special Economic Zone, Batam, Riau Islands; direct fibre to Singapore, 15+ submarine cables; marketed as operational campus. DayOne official page A for marketed campus; first phase operational, full 72MW buildout per operator.

name: DayOne Batam Kabil Expansion (2nd hyperscale)
notes: Second DayOne hyperscale data center in Kabil Industrial Estate, Batam: largest Indonesian data center PPA signed 17 Apr 2026 with PT PLN Batam for ~511 MVA (~450MW grid capacity) plus connectivity/fibre MoUs; backed by BP Batam. Operator release A; PLN official PJBTL disclosure A- per methodology; power agreement precedes construction.

name: NeutraDC Nxera Batam (Kabil)
developer: NeutraDC (Telkom) / Singtel Nxera / Medco Power JV
notes: NeutraDC Nxera Batam in Kabil Industrial Area: JV of Singtel Nxera, Telkom, Medco Power, Rp1.4 trillion investment; piling ceremony Jun 2024, topped out 2025, go-live targeted H1 2026; AI-ready hyperscale campus with solar/renewable supply MoU with Medco Power. DCD/W.Media/Katadata B; capacity not officially disclosed (null).

name: Data Center First Nongsa One (Batam)
notes: PT Data Center First Nongsa One in Nongsa, Batam: Tier 3, 31MW capacity in two phases, groundbreaking 25 Jul 2022 (CNBC Indonesia B). Terasbatam reports 40MW/28,730 sqm claims (C). Status: phase construction/operational partial per trade reports; capacity 31MW per CNBC.

name: neuCentrIX Batam Center
notes: neuCentrIX Batam Center (Jl. Laksamana Bintan, Baloi Permai) listed on official neuCentrIX location page among 17 cities; carrier-neutral edge DC for Sumatera/SEA interconnection. A for official listing; racks/capacity not disclosed.

name: neuCentrIX Medan
notes: neuCentrIX Medan Centrum (Jl. Balaikota No.1, Medan) on official neuCentrIX location page; one of 5 Telkom DCs in Sumatra (Medan, Batam, Pekanbaru, Palembang, Tanjung Karang); regional edge/colo hub for North Sumatra. A for official listing; capacity not disclosed (DCD notes 1,000+ racks across 23 Telkom facilities).

name: neuCentrIX Pekanbaru
notes: neuCentrIX Pekanbaru (Jl. Jendral Sudirman no.199), first Telkom DC in Riau with DiCo digital corner; official Telkom inauguration release + official location page. Operational edge/colo facility; capacity not disclosed.

name: neuCentrIX Jayapura
notes: neuCentrIX Jayapura inaugurated 4 Dec 2025: 28th Telkom neuCentrIX and first data center in Papua; Tier-II edge facility with 96 racks per trade reports; backed by Papua provincial government statement. Telkom official A; 96 racks B.

name: IDC Indonesia Makassar (Menara Bosowa)
developer: PT Internetindo Data Center Indonesia (IDC Indonesia) / Bosowa
notes: IDC Makassar, Gedung Menara Bosowa Lt.6, Jl. Jendral Sudirman No.5, Makassar, South Sulawesi - first public data centre in eastern Indonesia; enterprise colocation. Company page A for existence; capacity not disclosed (Baxtel C for metadata).

name: neuCentrIX Makassar (Mattoangin / Batu Ampar II)
notes: neuCentrIX Makassar (Batu Ampar II, Jl. Matoangin, Makassar) on official location page; tier-2 with ~50 full racks + 15 sub racks per Baxtel (C). Eastern Indonesia interconnection hub. A for official listing.

name: neuCentrIX Palembang
notes: neuCentrIX Palembang commercialized per Telkom/Antara (one of 5 Sumatra Telkom DCs: Medan, Batam, Pekanbaru, Palembang); PeeringDB lists neuCentriX Talang Kelapa, Palembang (C). Regional edge/colo for South Sumatra. Nusantara NDC Palembang also reported via directory (C, unverified).

name: neuCentrIX Manado
notes: neuCentrIX Manado (Jl. Wiratama No.2), tier-2, 460 sqm facility with 227 sqm IT hall, inaugurated 17 Jan 2019 at Second Gateway connectivity hub for eastern Indonesia. Telkom official + Antara A/B. Capacity not disclosed.

name: neuCentrIX Ulin Banjarmasin
notes: neuCentrIX Ulin Banjarmasin (Jl. Ahmad Yani), 2nd neuCentrIX in Kalimantan (18th nationally), inaugurated 8 Apr 2021; tier-2, 29 racks, 99.741% availability. Telkom official A; rack count B/C.

name: neuCentrIX Pugeran (Yogyakarta)
notes: neuCentrIX Pugeran launched 10 Oct 2024: Telkom's 25th data center and 2nd in Yogyakarta (after Kotabaru, listed on official location page as Jogjakarta Kota Baru). Official Telkom release A; capacity not disclosed.

name: neuCentrIX Pontianak
notes: neuCentrIX Pontianak (Jl. Teuku Umar No.2) inaugurated 8 Feb 2023: 4th Telkom edge data center in Kalimantan, capacity 57 racks, part of 7-cluster national DC ecosystem serving IKN/Kalimantan. Telkom/Antara A; 57 racks B.
